name: Kagekatsu
source:
Kagekatsu is a distinctive Puchi Hanny with formal Samurai attire and attitude that lives in Genbu Castle. 

[spoiler]It's there that he met Rizna, the lonely girl trapped inside by Genbu's curse. After many years of mental ordeal, Kagekatsu was her first friend and ally in years, and is the main reason she had managed to stay sane throughout her years of confinement.[/spoiler]

[From [url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/Kagekatsu]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
